title: Why We Underestimate Small Repeated Effort
short_teaser: A small action may seem insignificant when viewed once.
story: A small action may seem insignificant when viewed once. Repeated across weeks or months, it can create a result that intuition fails to predict. The mind notices dramatic events more easily than accumulation. Curiosity loosens assumptions. A better question can reveal options that certainty would have hidden. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
